//: BoGo -shim-config for tools/bogo_shim.zig (roadmap 0.3). This is the
//_: onyx-side integration surface for BoringSSL's ssl/test/runner, which
//__: is an OUT-OF-REPO harness: `tools/bogo.sh` pins a BoringSSL checkout and
//___: runs `go test` in ssl/test/runner with `-shim-config` pointed here.
//____: DisabledTests encodes onyx's modern-only posture (families the shim
//_____: intentionally does not implement are not run at all; flags outside the
//______: shim subset exit 89 and -allow-unimplemented skips them). ErrorMap maps
//_______: BoringSSL error constants to substrings of the onyx error names the
//________: shim prints to stderr. A DisabledTests entry is ONLY for a deliberate
//_________: posture or for BoringSSL-specific behaviour the RFCs leave optional;
//__________: genuine Armor defects stay enabled and fail visibly (they are simply

DisabledTests.FallbackSCSV: client offers max TLS 1.1, which modern-only rejects with protocol_version before the RFC 7507 check
DisabledTests.ConflictingVersionNegotiation: expects TLS 1.1 to be negotiated via supported_versions; modern-only
DisabledTests.V2ClientHello-*: no SSLv2-compatible ClientHello (RFC 5246 Appendix E.2 is MAY)
DisabledTests.Basic-Server-RSA-*: ECDHE-only: TLS_RSA_* (static-RSA key exchange) suites unsupported
DisabledTests.Basic-Client-RSA-*: ECDHE-only: TLS_RSA_* (static-RSA key exchange) suites unsupported
DisabledTests.NoCommonCurves: TLS 1.2 non-ECDHE fallback requires static-RSA key exchange; ECDHE-only
DisabledTests.*HelloRetryRequest*: shim runs 1.3-only or dual with a usable key_share; server-forced HRR out of scope
DisabledTests.*HRR*: HelloRetryRequest out of scope for the shim subset
DisabledTests.*P-384*: groups limited to x25519 / secp256r1 / X25519MLKEM768
DisabledTests.*P-521*: groups limited to x25519 / secp256r1 / X25519MLKEM768
DisabledTests.*P384*: ECDSA certificates limited to P-256 (no P-384 signing)
DisabledTests.*P521*: ECDSA certificates limited to P-256 (no P-521 signing)
DisabledTests.CheckECDSACurve-NotApplicable-TLS13: client offers only a P-384 key share; P-384 key exchange unsupported
DisabledTests.*SHA1*: modern-only: no SHA-1 signature schemes (RFC 8446 §4.2.3 legacy)
DisabledTests.*ML-DSA*: no ML-DSA TLS signature scheme yet (audit Phase 4 item 9)
DisabledTests.*Ed25519-TLS12: the hardened TLS 1.2 engine authenticates with ECDSA/RSA only
DisabledTests.NoExtendedMasterSecret-*: hardened TLS 1.2 requires extended_master_secret (RFC 7627 §5.3 allows aborting)
DisabledTests.DuplicateKeyShares-TLS13: RFC 8446 §4.2.8: servers MAY (not MUST) reject duplicate key shares
DisabledTests.GarbageInitialRecordVersion-TLS13: RFC 8446 §5.1: legacy_record_version MUST be ignored for all purposes on the 1.3 path
DisabledTests.DuplicateCertCompressionExt-*: compress_certificate not offered by this config; unknown extensions are ignored (RFC 8446 §4.2)
DisabledTests.PAKE-Extension-Duplicate: PAKE extension unimplemented; unknown extensions are ignored (RFC 8446 §4.2)
DisabledTests.ServerCertificateType-Server-RejectsDefa: RFC 7250 raw public keys disabled in this config; the extension is ignored
DisabledTests.ExtensionTrailingData-CertificateAuthori: certificate_authorities is not consumed by the server; ignored (RFC 8446 §4.2)
DisabledTests.RejectEmptyCertificateAuthorities-*: certificate_authorities is not consumed by the server; ignored (RFC 8446 §4.2)
DisabledTests.ExtendedMasterSecret-YesToNo-Server: hardened TLS 1.2 requires extended_master_secret on every handshake (RFC 7627 §5.3)
DisabledTests.Resume-Server-CipherNotPreferred: the initial session requires a CBC suite; AEAD-only
DisabledTests.SupportTicketsWithSessionID: no stateful session-ID cache; TLS 1.2 resumption is ticket-only (RFC 5077)
DisabledTests.Resume-Server-NoTickets-*: no stateful session-ID cache; TLS 1.2 resumption is ticket-only (RFC 5077)
DisabledTests.Resume-Server-CipherNotPreferred-TLS13: RFC 8446 §4.2.11 lets a server resume at any suite with the PSK hash; BoringSSL-specific preference
DisabledTests.*EarlyData*: 0-RTT not yet driven by the shim
DisabledTests.*ClientAuth*: mTLS / client certificates not yet driven by the shim
DisabledTests.*DelegatedCredential*: delegated credentials not driven by the shim

//____________: ErrorMap values are string ARRAYS as of BoringSSL's current runner
//______________: BoringSSL error maps to the set of onyx error-name substrings. The
//_______________: engines use coarser names than BoringSSL (BadHandshake covers both
//________________: malformed and out-of-order handshake messages; BadRecord covers
//_________________: non-TLS bytes), so several constants share one onyx name. The runner
//__________________: still checks the alert the shim sends (expectedLocalError) separately.
